The work, closely
No. 014 — LOBBY COMMISSION  - STRATA  · FRAMED

A custom art piece for a lobby in Beverly Hills.

Cast in three pours over six weeks; the surface was left to oxidize before final seal. The client asked for calm — the crack running through the base was not removed.

Cement, plaster16 × 24 × 2 in~10 lb
No. 009 — 48" x 48" - Inspired a horizontal COMMISSION

The beginning of a 72" x 48" custom piece.

Plaster ground with ash carried back from [site]; the surface is unsealed and still aging. Order and constraint, bouting with unpredictability.

Plaster and pigment48 × 48 × 2.5 in~90 lb
